title: One founding on empty sites?
hook: What preceded the colonial institutions in Cebu and Maynila?

knows: Selected historical records can describe distinct institutions and source levels.

claims.text: NHCP’s marker attributes a 1565 Cebu agreement to Tupas and Legazpi; it is not the original treaty. Intramuros describes Soliman’s existing Maynila fort, Spanish conquest and the 1571 colonial-capital role. These are different local acts, not empty sites or a simultaneous foundation; neither marker nor conquest establishes universal consent.

claims.text: What defeats the simultaneous empty-site foundation story? Named Tupas/Soliman institutions precede the selected colonial relations. The 1565 marker-attributed Cebu agreement differs from 1571 Maynila conquest and capital designation.
